newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher ahead of SEBI meeting.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher ahead of SEBI meeting.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse closed higher on Friday on expectations that the stockmarket watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), might introduce capital market reforms at a meeting next week.
The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index ended 3.40 points higher at 785.93 points.
SEBi is scheduled to meet on March 26.

Brokers said financial institutions made selective purchases in multinational corporations' shares, but restricted buying ahead of the long weekend. The bourse will be closed on Monday for the Indian festival of Holi.

"Foreign institutional investors and domestic financial institutions were major participants through the session. Gains were confined to selective stocks," said Harish Malhotra of brokers Malhotra Financial Services.
Reliance Industries shares rose 1.45 rupees to 290.45 after rising to 292.25 in early trade.
State Bank of India gained 3.20 rupees, closing at 317.95, on steady buying by the Unit Trust of India.

Nestle India gained 3.10 rupees, closing at 230.10. The company on Thursday announced a 528 million rupee net profit for the year ended December 31, 1996, against a 416 million rupee profit for the previous year.
Hindustan Lever Ltd shares closed seven rupees higher at 1,002 after the firm announced a 4.14 billion rupee net profit for the year ending December 31, 1996.
